The six pair tasks had present bounded recovery evidence, below the old half unit ceiling and at most an eighth per ordinary breath. Lin could not enlarge them into the local sixty usable and ninety one percent small circuit criterion or the required three changed trials. The next supervised revision would be Day 690. Until then no further input was assigned. Wei recorded the failed preparation beside the recovered finding rather than removing the error now that some capacity had returned. The record described one changing body.

mine_p17_after_014.speaker: narrator
mine_p17_after_014.text: On Day 669 Lin checked the ordinary touch, permitted grip, and leg movement as instructed after normal sleep and breakfast. No stated warning change appeared, and she reported that through the agreed followup contact within the completed review's limited next day record. A normal self report did not replace qualified diagnosis if a change arose. Wei retained the bounded result and the future supervised date. Lin stayed outside further input practice. The recovered primary tasks could now inform a careful revised curriculum, with the still unqualified bridge remaining a separate task that had already taught her the cost of haste.

mine_p17_after_015.speaker: narrator
mine_p17_after_015.text: Lei listened to her chosen practical result at supper and asked whether she felt like herself again. Lin said she felt more like someone who had made the same body wait for actual evidence. He preferred the less elegant answer. His own sorting job had become familiar, but the right hand's permanent gap was still difficult at the wash basin. They discussed the new glove fitting he had finally chosen from his own received wages, with its maker's accepted ordinary scope. A useful covering would fit the changed hand; it would not pretend the missing fingers could do work.

mine_p17_after_016.speaker: narrator
mine_p17_after_016.text: Mu brought the repaired screen frame for its owner to collect, then sat only after her paid contact ended. Lin told her about the stopped interval before the next supervised lesson. Mu said waiting felt different when the next step had an actual date and no one expected secret progress in between. Lin agreed, thinking of the narrow source contacts and their returned materials. The mine's unresolved losses remained unresolved where the work could not recover them. Her recovered primary route was a present bounded fact, not evidence that enough patience would make every other missing thing return.

mine_p17_after_017.speaker: narrator
mine_p17_after_017.text: The lamp at Han's window burned with a maintained wick. Lei had inspected its housing within his appropriate current task, and another sound worker had carried it to the household shelf. Lin watched the moth outside turn toward the warmth without entering a prophecy. Shen's permitted living refrain reached the yard from a worker's own remembered voice and ended where the sound ended. Lu Sen remained dead. The private originals remained lost or under their owners' actual custody. She could proceed toward a new findings decision with those facts intact, carrying her own candidate record and no larger borrowed authority.
